metadata.program: SkyraSoft HBOS Public Distribution & Multi-Tenant Platform Integrity Program

PLATFORM-GAP-001.title: IndexedDB Local Store Dynamic Multi-Tenant Namespacing & Safe Logout Isolation
PLATFORM-GAP-001.frontend_change: Dynamic database naming HBOS_Store_Biz_${id}, lifecycle hooks openTenantDatabase/closeTenantDatabase, logout memory and token detachment preserving on-disk offline queue.
PLATFORM-GAP-001.desktop_change: WebView2 sandboxed IndexedDB storage isolation per tenant.
PLATFORM-GAP-001.local_storage_change: Zero cross-tenant store visibility on shared PC.
PLATFORM-GAP-001.security_change: Eliminates cross-tenant product catalog and customer debt leaks on shared device.
PLATFORM-GAP-001.tests: Local database isolation test matrix and build verification.
PLATFORM-GAP-001.acceptance_criterion: Switching users or logging out isolates local database without deleting legitimate unsynced offline transactions.

PLATFORM-GAP-002.title: Tenantable & Branchable Model Scope Enforcement on SupplierReturn & ActivityLog
PLATFORM-GAP-002.backend_change: Attached Tenantable and Branchable traits to SupplierReturn model; ActivityLog automatically captures business_id and enforces tenant scoping in AuditLogController.
PLATFORM-GAP-002.security_change: Guarantees global TenantScope on SupplierReturn model queries, preventing cross-tenant IDOR access.
PLATFORM-GAP-002.acceptance_criterion: Direct foreign-tenant ID requests return 404 Not Found.

PLATFORM-GAP-003.title: Public Self-Service Authentication Rate Limiting & Abuse Prevention
PLATFORM-GAP-003.backend_change: Applied throttle:6,1 to /auth/login and /auth/register, and throttle:5,1 to /auth/forgot-password and /auth/reset-password.
PLATFORM-GAP-003.security_change: Protects against automated bot registrations and credential stuffing attacks.
PLATFORM-GAP-003.acceptance_criterion: Rapid consecutive requests exceed limit and return HTTP 429 Too Many Requests.

PLATFORM-GAP-004.title: Canonical Email Normalization across Registration, Login, and Password Recovery
PLATFORM-GAP-004.backend_change: Enforced strtolower(trim($email)) in register, login, forgotPassword, and resetPassword.
PLATFORM-GAP-004.security_change: Prevents duplicate account creation and login lockouts from email casing differences.
PLATFORM-GAP-004.acceptance_criterion: Case-varied email inputs resolve to identical canonical identity.

PLATFORM-GAP-005.title: Self-Service Password Recovery & Multi-Device Session Invalidation
PLATFORM-GAP-005.backend_change: Implemented forgotPassword, resetPassword, and logoutAllDevices endpoints with token expiry and session purge.
PLATFORM-GAP-005.frontend_change: Added logoutAllDevices action in Pinia auth store.
PLATFORM-GAP-005.security_change: Allows secure self-service password reset and remote session revocation across all terminals.
PLATFORM-GAP-005.acceptance_criterion: Password reset revokes all active Sanctum tokens; logoutAllDevices purges all user tokens.

PLATFORM-GAP-006.title: Windows Desktop Shell Packaging Architecture & Microsoft Store Readiness
PLATFORM-GAP-006.frontend_change: Production Vite bundle optimized for WebView2 and MSIX desktop packaging.
PLATFORM-GAP-006.desktop_change: Tauri desktop shell architecture specified with raw TCP Port 9100 thermal ESC/POS printing and sandboxed IndexedDB persistence.
PLATFORM-GAP-006.security_change: RFC1918 LAN private subnet security filter for local printer and kiosk pairing.
PLATFORM-GAP-006.tests: Frontend production build (171 modules, 0 errors) and WACK test runbook.
PLATFORM-GAP-006.acceptance_criterion: Architecture and build configuration ready for Microsoft Store MSIX packaging.

PLATFORM-GAP-007.title: Client/Server Version Handshake & Update Compatibility Gating
PLATFORM-GAP-007.backend_change: Created central version config, CheckClientVersion middleware, response headers, and HTTP 426 upgrade gating.
PLATFORM-GAP-007.frontend_change: Injected X-HBOS-App-Version and X-HBOS-Sync-Schema-Version in request interceptor; handled update events.
PLATFORM-GAP-007.security_change: Prevents incompatible older client versions from submitting corrupted offline sync payloads.
PLATFORM-GAP-007.acceptance_criterion: Client below minimum supported version receives HTTP 426 Upgrade Required.

PLATFORM-GAP-008.title: Atomic Initial Tenant Defaults Provisioning (Main Cash & Core Settings)
PLATFORM-GAP-008.backend_change: Seeded initial "Main Cash" financial account and core business receipt/invoice settings atomically during registration transaction.
PLATFORM-GAP-008.security_change: Guarantees fresh accounts have valid financial accounts and configuration without manual setup.
PLATFORM-GAP-008.acceptance_criterion: New signup immediately possesses active Main Cash account and core settings.

PLATFORM-GAP-009.title: Multi-Business Tenant Creation for Existing Authenticated Account
PLATFORM-GAP-009.backend_change: Underlying business_user pivot schema and ResolveActiveBusiness middleware remain 100% forward-compatible.
PLATFORM-GAP-009.acceptance_criterion: Initial public release focuses on single self-provisioned business per registration.

PLATFORM-GAP-010.title: Tenant-Partitioned Server File & Upload Storage Paths
PLATFORM-GAP-010.backend_change: Enforced businesses/{business_id}/brands and businesses/{business_id}/products upload storage directory partitioning.
PLATFORM-GAP-010.security_change: Prevents cross-tenant asset collisions and directory enumeration.
PLATFORM-GAP-010.acceptance_criterion: Files saved to disk are strictly partitioned by authenticated tenant ID.
